panels.prompt: Wide shot, dismounted party of armed travellers, wary, at abandoned campsite in bare winter forest past shallow ford with leafless apple trees; cold fire pit, trampled snow; grey birches, hoarfrost
Extreme close-up, gloved fingers lifting a grey feather from snow, small rooster mark burned into its quill; blonde braid and fur shoulder at right edge

Medium shot, young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow crouching at cold fire pit, palm held over the ash, eyes narrowed toward dark thicket; grey birches, moss, hoarfrost
Wide night shot, abandoned log hut with sagging roof in dark pine forest, orange firelight leaking through cracks between logs, horses tethered outside, breath steaming; deep cold blue

Medium shot inside log hut, japanese teen boy, black hair, blue eyes, noble cloak, glowing golden sword sitting hugging his knees, sword across knees, looking up with fragile searching face; small hearth fire, warm orange light

texts.text: Шин-сан… переход. Как это было у тебя? Может, это всё-таки… игра?
